title: Monoacylglycerol pathway of dietary fat absorption
compartment: Intestinal lumen, then endoplasmic reticulum of enterocytes

steps.note: Cleaves sn-1 and sn-3 esters; releases two fatty acids
Enterocyte ER; over 75% of postprandial intestinal TAG synthesis
Only DGAT detected in human intestine
Assembly requires APOB and microsomal triglyceride transfer protein (MTTP)
